  3. <fidel-offline-status>

<fidel-offline-status>

Offline status. One always-visible line, "Online." or "You are offline. 3 lessons are saved on this phone.", and a list of saved lessons.

Who it helps:ማንን ይረዳል፦ Learners whose connection comes and goes.

Live exampleየቀጥታ ምሳሌ

This example is live: try it with the keyboard, a mouse or touch, and a screen reader.ይህ ምሳሌ ቀጥታ ነው፦ በኪቦርድ፣ በማውዝ ወይም በንክኪ፣ እና በስክሪን አንባቢ ይሞክሩት።

Attributesመለያዎች (attributes)

Attributes of <fidel-offline-status>
AttributeValuesDefaultMeaning
ui-langen, amthe page's lang, else enLanguage of the component's own buttons and messages.

Eventsክስተቶች (events)

Events sent by <fidel-offline-status>
Eventevent.detailWhen
fidel-offline-status-change{ online }The connection changed.

Events bubble and carry no personal data. Listen with addEventListener, like any DOM event.

Keyboard and screen readerኪቦርድ እና ስክሪን አንባቢ

  • "Saved lessons" is a native <details> with links.
  • Screen readers hear the line only when the connection changes.

Languagesቋንቋዎች

Its own buttons and messages are in English or Amharic. Set ui-lang="am" on the tag (or on a parent); without it, the page's lang is used, else English.

Accessibility and WCAGተደራሽነት እና WCAG

  • 1.4.1 Use of Color: Online and offline are said in words.
  • 4.1.3 Status Messages: Announced only on change.
  • It counts the same cache as the player's "Save for offline" and <fidel-download-later>.

The full WCAG 2.2 AA conformance report
